{{Top|leg}}
This '''anatomy upgrade''' was a library of files and other reference material relating to the anatomy of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] creatures. It provided the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with an intimate knowledge of the strengths and weaknesses of humanoids.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
